en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch a documentary on bugs
Watch a documentary on athletes
Watch a documentary on magic tricks

I hate bugs. You never know what 
dark mage they belong to...

I'd be in trouble if my magical secrets 
were leaked cuz of their spies...

When I look closely, athletes are 
overflowing with mana...

If I could harness their energy, I 
could use it to craft a good spell.

You've increased the power of 
my magic. You should be proud.
Not tricks. It's magic, okay?

But anyway, is it okay to record 
magic being performed?

The mage's magical powers 
might break the equipment.

Or did this mage put warding 
enchantments on the cameras?
If so, this is a pretty skilled mage...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
(Nyeh...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Himiko's inner thoughts...?
